SMTO-EML-0016 — Your email has no message text

GUID: 294639de-38be-52ba-b431-d6abfa39ed85
Slug: email-body-required
Domain: EML · Subsystem: email-smtp

What happened

  • The email didn't include any message text, only blanks or nothing at all, so SMTO stopped before preparing it. Nothing was sent.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO in the conversation to send the email again, and tell it clearly what the message should say. SMTO needs message text to send; a subject and recipients alone aren't enough.
  2. If a schedule sends this email, open it from Schedules and make sure its instructions describe the message text. Scheduled runs only know what to write from their saved instructions.
  3. When the Approval needed card appears, check the message details before selecting Approve once. Approving only what you've checked keeps a blank or wrong email from going out.

What success looks like

  • SMTO reports the mail server accepted the message, and recipients see your text.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. This is about how the email was written, not your email account, so don't change your password or reconnect the account because of it.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The email.send request had neither a nonblank text_body nor a nonblank html_body, so local validation rejected it before any preparation or dispatch.

What this means

  • The email request has no nonblank text or HTML body. The producer identifies the failed field or preparation stage without exposing private values.

Why this can happen

  • Neither accepted body field contains non-whitespace text.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the reported field, failure phase and retained receipt before choosing a correction.

How to fix it

  • Supply a nonblank text_body or html_body in the email.send arguments and submit the corrected request. This is local validation (failure_phase validation, reason nonblank_body_required) and says nothing about credentials or delivery.
  • Supply a nonblank text_body or html_body, then submit the corrected email request.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the reported condition first. Retry only when existing execution and effect evidence permits it; reconcile an uncertain prior send.

How to verify the fix

  • The corrected request passes body validation.

What not to do

  • Do not infer an authentication rejection from local validation. Preserve the recorded execution and delivery evidence before any retry.

Technical notes

  • Do not infer an authentication rejection from local validation. Preserve the recorded execution and delivery evidence before any retry.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
